overview.zh-Hans:
在任务中阅读、整理和编辑 PDF：查找内容、导出页面图片、合并拆分、重排旋转页面，以及添加批注、页码和水印。也可处理正文修改、表单填写、图片和书签等内容，扫描件可通过文字识别辅助阅读与检索。

提供文件和具体需求后，它会协助完成修改或提取信息，并交付便于对照核查的新文档副本。涉及敏感内容的真正抹除，需要使用相应脱敏流程；普通改字、裁剪和批注不代表内容已安全删除。识别得到的文字可能有误，重要内容应结合原页核对。
overview.en:
Read, organize and edit PDFs within a task: find information, export page images, merge or split documents, reorder or rotate pages, and add annotations, page numbers or watermarks. It also guides text changes, form filling, images and bookmarks, with text recognition to help read and search scanned pages.

Provide the file and a specific request. The skill helps make the changes or extract the information, delivering a new document copy for comparison and review. Secure removal of sensitive content needs the appropriate redaction process; ordinary edits, crops and annotations do not establish secure deletion. Recognized text can contain errors, so important details should be checked against the original page.

useCases.zh-Hans: 把多份 PDF 按指定顺序合并，或抽取其中几页另存新文件
useCases.en: Merge several PDFs in an order you choose, or pull selected pages into a new file

useCases.zh-Hans: 直接修改正文措辞或标题，保留可搜索文本

useCases.zh-Hans: 给合同和报告加批注、填写表单后另存副本

useCases.zh-Hans: 为扫描件建立可搜索文字层，或在确认后完成整本脱敏
useCases.en: Make a scan searchable, or run a fully consented redaction

output.zh-Hans: 一个合并后的新 PDF，页面顺序与删页结果经过重新打开核对；三份原件保持不变。
output.en: A new merged PDF whose page order and removals were confirmed by reopening it; the three originals stay untouched.

prompt.en: Replace the old vendor name everywhere it appears in paragraph 2 on page 4, let it reflow with searchable text, then show me that page rendered.

output.zh-Hans: 一份编辑后的新 PDF 和第 4 页的渲染图；改不动的地方会明确说明原因，不会留下半完成的文件。
output.en: An edited copy plus a render of page 4; anything that can't be applied is explained, never half-saved.

output.zh-Hans: 带文字层的扫描件和基于真实识别内容导出的要点；没把握的位置会被指出，不会凭空补字。
output.en: The scan with a text layer plus a summary exported from the recognized text; shaky passages are flagged rather than invented.

overview.zh-Hans:
创建和修改真正的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 文件：从要点直接生成带标题和表格的文档、含公式的工作簿、带可编辑图表的演示稿——图表是真实的图表对象，背后带着数据，不是贴图。修改已有文件时先读取结构，再按位置精确改文字、样式、行列、冻结表头、排序筛选，或重排、对齐幻灯片元素。

所有改动都保存为新文件并在完成后重新打开确认；自动处理只会写出核对过的副本，你能对照它改了什么。Word、Markdown、HTML、RTF 之间的格式转换在设备本地完成，内容不会被重新转述一遍。

需要留意的边界：公式结果核对覆盖常用函数而非完整表格引擎；与编辑器里选中内容直接相关的操作，仍会在编辑器里等你确认；复杂排版的转换结果建议打开看一眼再定。
overview.en:
Create and edit real Word, Excel and PowerPoint files: turn bullet points into a structured document, a workbook with formulas, or a deck whose charts are genuine editable charts backed by their own data — not pictures of charts. When revising an existing file, it reads the structure first, then changes text, styles, rows and columns, frozen headers, sorting and filters, or slide order and alignment, exactly where intended.

Every change saves as a new file that gets reopened and confirmed; automated edits produce a checked copy you can compare against the original. Conversions between Word, Markdown, HTML and RTF run locally on the device without retyping your content.

Worth knowing: formula-result checking covers common functions, not a full spreadsheet engine; operations tied to what's selected in the editor wait for you there; complex layouts deserve a quick look after conversion.

useCases.zh-Hans: 把笔记或报告要点变成带可编辑图表的演示文稿
useCases.en: Turn notes or a report into a deck with editable, real-data charts

useCases.zh-Hans: 生成预算工作簿，设数字格式、冻结表头并排序
useCases.en: Build a budget workbook with number formats, a frozen header and sorting

useCases.zh-Hans: 在现有 Word 稿里精确替换措辞并统一样式，保留原件
useCases.en: Replace exact wording and styles in an existing Word file without touching the original

useCases.zh-Hans: 把一批 Markdown 文档离线转换成 Word 或 HTML
useCases.en: Convert a set of Markdown documents to Word or HTML offline

prompt.zh-Hans: 用这份季度数据做一份 8 页复盘演示稿：趋势用柱状图，渠道占比用饼图，图表要能在 PowerPoint 里继续改数据。

output.zh-Hans: 一个演示文稿文件，图表带着真实数据可继续编辑；页数、图表与文字经重新打开核对。
output.en: A presentation whose charts carry real, editable data; slides, charts and text confirmed by reopening the file.

prompt.zh-Hans: 把报销表按金额降序排一遍并冻结首行，第一行是表头，不要当成数据。
prompt.en: Sort the expense sheet by amount descending and freeze the top row — the first row is a header, not data.

output.zh-Hans: 一份核对过的编辑副本（原件不动），排序与冻结状态重新打开确认，表头保留原位。
output.en: A verified edited copy (original untouched), sorting and the frozen row confirmed on reopening, header left in place.

prompt.zh-Hans: 这份 Word 说明书里的旧产品名全部替换成新名，正文样式别乱，改完给我一份改动清单。
prompt.en: Replace every old product name in this Word manual with the new one without disturbing the styles, then show me what changed.

output.zh-Hans: 一份新文档和逐处替换清单；文件中途被改过会先停下来重新读取，不会覆盖你的新版本。
output.en: A new file with a change list per replacement; if the document changed meanwhile it re-reads first instead of overwriting.

overview.zh-Hans:
这台设备本身就是一台网络体检仪：查域名解析、测指定端口是否连通、做带延迟和丢包统计的 ping、沿路追踪连接经过的每一跳，全部从本机发起，不需要登录任何服务器。还能按你的要求列出局域网内的设备、用自定义的方法和请求头调试 API，或把允许下载的链接保存成工作区文件。

读网页内容请使用应用自带的网页能力；这个条目专注网络层面的连通性判断。每一次诊断都是真实探测，报告会说清每一步测到了什么——端口不通和延迟高是两回事，它不会混为一谈。
overview.en:
This device doubles as a network bench: resolve a domain, probe whether a specific service port answers, run a bounded ping with per-reply latency and loss, and trace each hop a connection travels — all from here, no server login required. On request it lists devices on your local network, issues API calls with your own method and headers for debugging, and saves an authorized download into your workspace.

Reading a web page as content stays with the app's web surfaces; this entry is about connectivity itself. Every report reflects probes that actually ran and says what each step measured — a closed port and a slow link are different answers, and never blended into one.

useCases.zh-Hans: 网站打不开时按 DNS → TCP → ping → traceroute 定位卡在哪一环
useCases.en: When a site won't load, trace whether DNS, the port, ICMP or a hop is failing

useCases.zh-Hans: 检查某台服务器的具体端口是否可达
useCases.en: Check whether a specific service port on a server is reachable

useCases.zh-Hans: 枚举局域网设备，排查打印机或盒子是否在线
useCases.en: Enumerate LAN devices to check whether a printer or box is online

useCases.zh-Hans: 带请求头调试 API，或把授权资源文件保存到工作区
useCases.en: Debug an API with custom headers, or save an authorized resource into the workspace

prompt.zh-Hans: api.example.com 今天连不上，先查解析，再测 443 端口，然后 ping 和 traceroute 各跑一轮，告诉我断在哪。
prompt.en: api.example.com is unreachable today. Look up DNS, probe port 443, then run a ping set and a traceroute, and tell me where it breaks.

output.zh-Hans: 四段真实探测记录：解析结果、端口连通性、逐包延迟与丢包、逐跳地址和延迟，并指出最可能的断点位置。
output.en: Four real probe results: resolution, port reachability, per-packet latency with loss, and per-hop addresses — plus where the break most likely sits.

prompt.en: List the devices currently on my home LAN, then download this public firmware-notes PDF into the workspace.

output.zh-Hans: 一份局域网设备枚举结果和已保存到工作区的文件；下载只针对你授权公开的地址。
output.en: A LAN enumeration plus the saved workspace file; downloads are limited to the authorized address you named.

overview.zh-Hans:
先把视频或音频看清楚：编码格式、分辨率、帧率、时长、采样率、声道数，一项项列出来，再决定怎么转。支持常见的处理：视频转码、只换封装不动画面质量的容器转换、音频格式转换。处理前会确认这台设备当前真的具备该能力才开始；输出文件重新打开检查过才交给你，源文件始终保留，失败或取消都不会丢原片。

边界要说清：这里做的是可靠的格式转换，不是剪辑软件——没有补帧、超分、画面修复、人声分离或时间轴编辑。拿不准能不能转，先问一句，它会给你明确答复而不是硬试。
overview.en:
Look first, convert second: it lists a media file's actual codec, resolution, frame rate, duration, sample rate and channels, then chooses the right job — video transcode, container swap that leaves the picture untouched, or audio format conversion. It verifies the capability is ready on this device before starting, reopens and checks the output before delivering, and always keeps your source file: a failed or cancelled job never costs you the original.

The scope is dependable conversion, not an editor: no frame interpolation, upscaling, restoration, voice-stem splitting or timeline work. Unsure whether something can convert? Ask — you'll get a straight answer instead of a gamble.

useCases.en: Convert phone-shot HEVC clips into a format your editing software accepts

useCases.zh-Hans: 拿到未知媒体文件先做完整技术参数体检
useCases.en: Profile an unknown media file's actual technical parameters first

output.en: A new .mp4 with picture parameters, duration and playability confirmed by reopening; the original .mkv stays.

output.en: An honest source profile plus a verified MP3 — or a plain explanation of why that conversion isn't available right now.

overview.zh-Hans:
帮你把零散想法、资料和反馈整理成一份完整文档，适合方案、报告、产品说明和内部提案。可以从一句需求开始，也可以接着已有草稿继续修改。

提供文档目的、读者、背景资料和语气偏好后，它会协助梳理提纲、逐节撰写，并结合你的反馈调整结构与表达；每一轮改了哪里、为什么改，都会留下简短记录，方便你随时回到任何一版继续。定稿前再从读者角度检查一遍：有没有遗漏、论据够不够、前后是否一致，帮助你得到一份清楚、连贯、便于继续编辑的文稿。
overview.en:
It turns scattered thoughts, materials and feedback into a complete document — proposals, reports, product write-ups, internal pitches. Start from a single sentence of intent, or keep editing a draft you already have.

Share the document's purpose, its readers, the background and your tone preference, and it helps shape an outline, write section by section, and adjust structure and wording as you react. Each revision round keeps a short record of what changed and why, so you can pick up from any version. Before delivery it re-reads the draft the way a reader would — gaps, support, consistency — leaving you a clear, coherent document that's easy to keep editing.

useCases.zh-Hans: 把散乱的会议记录与材料整理成有结构的立项提案
useCases.en: Turn scattered meeting notes and material into a structured proposal

useCases.zh-Hans: 逐节扩写规格文档并保留每轮修改理由
useCases.en: Expand a spec section by section while keeping a reasoned change log

useCases.zh-Hans: 交付前做盲点与事实复核，补上最强反对意见的回答
useCases.en: Run the blind-spot and fact re-check before delivery, answering the strongest objections

useCases.zh-Hans: 迭代已发布版本：另存新文件、导出 Word/PDF 并回读验证
useCases.en: Iterate a released version as a new file, exporting and reopening Word/PDF to verify

prompt.zh-Hans: 根据这些会议记录和竞品笔记起草一份市场进入决策文档：先给我提纲和每节的一句话目标，数字没来源的先标出来。
prompt.en: Draft a market-entry decision doc from these meeting notes and competitor memos: outline first with a one-sentence goal per section, flagging every figure that lacks a source.

output.zh-Hans: 一份提纲和资料梳理，需要补来源的位置单独标出；你确认提纲后再逐节成稿。
output.en: An outline plus organized background with spots needing sources marked; section drafts follow your approval.

prompt.zh-Hans: 这份提案已经定稿，别重写——只扮演怀疑的投资人，列出三个最强反对意见，并指出文稿哪里答不上。
prompt.en: This proposal is final — don't rewrite it. Play the skeptical investor: list the three strongest objections and show which ones the draft fails to answer.

output.zh-Hans: 按出现概率排序的反对意见清单，逐条指向相关章节与缺口，由你决定如何补。
output.en: Objections ranked by likelihood, each pinned to the section where the draft falls short — your call how to answer them.

overview.zh-Hans:
把内部沟通写成对读者真正有用的文档：状态报告、给管理层的更新、公司简报、常见问题、事故通报，每一种都有自己的写法。同一件事，写给工程团队、管理层和全员，该先说什么、略掉什么、用什么语气都不同——它会先和你确认读者、目的和节奏，再动笔。

公司专有的人名、频率和模板保持空缺并向你询问，不会编造。成稿是普通文档（Word、Markdown 或手记），随文附必要的数据和出处；它只负责写，发送、发布、共享都由你走应用自己的入口完成。
overview.en:
Internal communication written to be useful to its readers: status reports, leadership updates, company newsletters, FAQs and incident reports each have their own craft. The same news lands differently for engineers, executives or an all-hands audience — what to lead with, what to drop, what tone fits. It confirms audience, purpose and cadence with you before writing.

Company-specific names, cadences and templates stay as blanks it asks about rather than invents. Deliverables are ordinary documents — Word, Markdown or Notes — with the needed data and sources attached. It only writes: sending, posting and sharing stay your actions through the app's own surfaces.

useCases.zh-Hans: 把本周工程进展整理成给管理层的一页式更新
useCases.en: Condense the week's engineering progress into a one-page leadership update

useCases.zh-Hans: 为一次线上事故起草对外温和、对内可执行的通报
useCases.en: Draft an incident report that reads calm outwardly and actionable inwardly

useCases.zh-Hans: 汇总团队动态成月度简报，含公告与致谢板块
useCases.en: Assemble team news into a monthly newsletter with announcements and shout-outs

useCases.zh-Hans: 把重复被问的问题写成口径一致的 FAQ 回答
useCases.en: Turn repeatedly-asked questions into consistently-answered FAQs

prompt.zh-Hans: 这是本周三条变更和一条延期：写给 VP 的版本要突出风险与决策点，全员版要平实、给上下文，各出一份并保留占位的数字来源。
prompt.en: Here are three changes and one slip this week: the VP version must foreground risk and the decision needed, the all-hands version plain with context — produce both, keeping unsourced figures as placeholders.

output.zh-Hans: 两份受众校准的工作区文档，延期事项如实呈现，未核实的数字标注待补。
output.en: Two audience-calibrated workspace documents, the slip stated honestly and unverified figures marked for sourcing.

prompt.zh-Hans: 按我们的事故复盘记录写一份不甩锅的通报：时间线、影响面、已恢复动作、后续整改各一段，别加没记录里的原因。
prompt.en: From our incident postmortem notes, write a no-blame report: timeline, blast radius, recovery steps and follow-ups as four sections, with nothing beyond the record.

output.zh-Hans: 结构完整的通报草稿，每条影响和动作可指回复盘记录，未确认的根因明确留白。
output.en: A complete report draft where every impact and action traces to the postmortem, with unconfirmed root causes explicitly left open.

overview.zh-Hans:
给中文加英文的文档做一次系统的文风体检：用词是否具体、标题层级是否规范、数字和单位是否统一、句子是否过长、术语前后是否一致。中英双语稿件还会多走一遍：两个版本说的是不是同一件事——漏掉的句子、对不上的数字、跑偏的语气都会被指出来。

每条问题都标明位置和依据，先给你一份可逐条决定的清单；只有你要求时它才动手改，改动保留原稿版本，改完再核对一遍。风格问题可以检查，事实真假不能：查不到来源的说法只会标注「需要来源」，不会被润色过去。
overview.en:
A systematic style check for your documents: concrete versus abstract wording, clean heading levels, unified numbers and units, sentence length, terminology used the same way throughout. Bilingual drafts get an extra pass — do the Chinese and English versions actually say the same thing? Dropped sentences, mismatched figures and drifting tone surface here.

Every issue arrives with its location and basis, as an accept-or-reject list; direct edits happen only when you ask, and the original stays as its own version, re-checked after editing. Style is checkable, truth isn't: an unverifiable claim gets marked 'needs a source' instead of being smoothed over.

useCases.en: Sweep a README or help docs for style and consistency before release

useCases.zh-Hans: 揪出文档里前后矛盾的数值、版本号和术语
useCases.en: Catch conflicting numbers, versions and terminology inside one document

useCases.en: Verify bilingual drafts keep the same claims, numbers and caveats

prompt.zh-Hans: 对这份 API 指南做文风检查，只报告不要改：每条问题给出位置、依据和原文。
prompt.en: Run a style pass on this API guide and report only, no edits: location, basis and quoted text per issue.

output.zh-Hans: 按类别分组的问题清单，含术语与数字一致性核对、以及标注「需要来源」的句子，原文件不动。
output.en: A category-grouped issue list with the terminology-and-figures consistency check and 'needs a source' flags, original untouched.

prompt.zh-Hans: 这份中文用户提示和英文版最近改过，检查两边说法、数字、限制条件还有没有对不上的地方，顺手统一术语。
prompt.en: The Chinese and English versions of these user prompts drifted after edits — check paired claims, numbers and caveats, then unify terminology.

output.zh-Hans: 双语差异报告与逐条修订建议，中文标点保持原样，改完再核对一遍。
output.en: A bilingual drift report with itemized fixes, Chinese punctuation left intact, re-checked after editing.

overview.zh-Hans:
为页面写能促成行动的文案，而不是漂亮话。动笔前会和你确认：页面类型、最想让人做的那一件事、目标客户和他们描述问题的原话、产品真正的差异点和证据。有品牌语气资料就先沿用，只补空缺。

方法上守四条：清楚胜过俏皮，收益胜过功能，具体胜过含糊，客户的语言胜过公司黑话；不造数据、不编证言。产出是可直接使用的主张句、标题候选、分节正文和行动按钮文案；竞品页面与受众用语可以用应用内置的检索来核实。它只写文案，发布由你决定；想逐行精修，可以接着用文稿编辑。
overview.en:
Copy written to move people, not to impress them. Before drafting, you settle the page type, the one action it should drive, who the customer is and the exact words they use for their problem, plus the product's real difference and proof. Any brand-voice material you have is used first; only gaps get asked.

Four rules hold: clarity over cleverness, benefit over feature, specific over vague, customer language over company jargon — and no invented statistics or testimonials. You receive a working value proposition, headline candidates, section copy and calls to action; competitor pages and audience phrasing can be checked with the app's built-in search. It writes; publishing stays your decision, and line-by-line polishing continues in copy-editing.

useCases.zh-Hans: 给新产品落地页写主张、三段卖点与 CTA 全套

useCases.en: Rewrite an existing page using competitor research and real customer phrasing

useCases.zh-Hans: 定价页或邮件落地页的多标题候选与小步 A/B 变体
useCases.en: Headline candidates and small variants for pricing or email landing pages

prompt.zh-Hans: 为这款离线转录工具写落地页：受众是被云收费和隐私条款搞烦的小团队，主行动是试用下载；给我 5 个标题、去含糊化的副文案和 CTA。
prompt.en: Write a landing page for this offline transcription tool: audience is small teams tired of cloud pricing and privacy fine print, the one action is a trial download. Give 5 headlines, a de-vagued subhead and CTAs.

output.zh-Hans: 一套含具体收益语言的主张与候选标题，标注各自假设，未证实数字一律留白待你补。
output.en: A specific-benefit value prop with headline candidates, each annotated with its assumption, and no unverified numbers.

prompt.zh-Hans: 这段文案满是「赋能、闭环、抓手」，改成人话：意思不许变，客户语言优先，改完列一条「原句 → 新句 → 理由」。
prompt.en: This copy is stuffed with buzzwords. Rewrite it in human language without changing meaning, prefer customer words, and list original → rewrite → reason per line.

output.zh-Hans: 逐行改写对照表与新正文；空心词、假数据和夸大被替换或标出。
output.en: A line-by-line rewrite table with the clean copy; hollow words, invented data and hype replaced or flagged.

overview.zh-Hans:
改稿不是重写。这个流程把修改拆成七遍各有侧重的扫描，每一遍只看一件事：先查读者能不能看懂，再查语气是否前后一致，然后追问每个说法「所以对读者意味着什么」「拿什么证明」，接着把抽象词换成具体场景和数字，保留该有的情绪、删掉推卸责任的套话。改完会回头确认之前的改进没有被破坏。

它在你真实的文件上工作：从工作区或手记读取原文，产出一份修改版新文件和逐条修改理由，原件保持不动。可读性等指标会量化对比，确保越改越清楚；事实需要核对时走应用自带的检索，查不到就标注存疑，不为顺口而编。
overview.en:
Editing isn't rewriting. The job splits into seven focused passes, one dimension each: can the reader understand it; is the voice consistent; what does each claim mean for the buyer and what proves it; abstractions replaced with concrete scenes and numbers; the right emotion preserved; liability-hedging clichés cut. Each pass re-checks that earlier improvements survived.

It works on your actual copy — read from the workspace or Notes — and delivers an edited new file with a reason per change, the original left intact. Readability and similar measures are compared before and after so improvements are real, not cosmetic; when a claim needs checking it uses the app's own search, and unverifiable bits stay flagged instead of being smoothed.

useCases.zh-Hans: 上线前把落地页文案按七遍框架系统过一遍
useCases.en: Run launch copy through the seven-sweep framework before shipping

useCases.zh-Hans: 同事的推广邮件越改越像公文——拉回原有声音
useCases.en: Pull a colleague's promo email back to its original voice

useCases.zh-Hans: 给夸张的市场主张逐条找证据或降级措辞
useCases.en: Demand evidence for bold marketing claims or downgrade them honestly

useCases.zh-Hans: 要「问题 → 建议改法 → 理由」的可拒绝清单
useCases.en: Receive an accept/reject list of issue → rewrite → reason

prompt.zh-Hans: 这份产品发布邮件别重写，按七遍流程过：清晰、语气、读者收益、证据……每遍给我单独的问题清单。
prompt.en: Don't rewrite this launch email — run the seven passes. Give me each pass's issues separately: clarity, voice, reader payoff, evidence…

output.zh-Hans: 按扫描维度分组的问题与改写建议，附可读性等指标的前后对比，原稿不动。
output.en: Findings grouped per editing pass with rewrite suggestions and before/after readability measures, original untouched.

prompt.zh-Hans: 这段文案里所有「行业领先」「大幅提升」这类说法，能查到证据的标证据，查不到的给出降级后的诚实版本。
prompt.en: Every 'industry-leading' or 'massively improves' claim in this copy: mark ones with verifiable evidence, and rewrite the rest into honest, downgraded versions.

output.zh-Hans: 带证据标注与逐条降级措辞的编辑副本；改后核对指标，确认没有越改越糟。
output.en: An edited copy with evidence tags and honest downgrades per claim, re-checked afterward to confirm no regression.

overview.zh-Hans:
从选题到可发布成稿的生产流程，三段各管一段：调研与简报——看看目标关键词下已经排着的内容都是什么角度、读者搜时想要什么、还有什么没被讲清楚，再找三到五个可引用的来源，形成一份写作简报；写作——按简报结构写出完整正文；优化——检查搜索表现、可读性、结构、页面摘要信息与内链，给出可交付版本。可以顺序跑完，也可以直接进入任何一段。

规矩是硬的：说不出具体数字就不许写「研究表明」；标题不能承诺正文没给的东西；每个主张和数据都能回指保存过的来源。成稿、来源清单和配图资料一起存在你的工作区里。

它是生产线不是发布渠道：不自动发布、不代发，最终交回你审阅和你自己的渠道。选题太宽泛时，它会先追问读者是谁、解决什么问题。
overview.en:
Production from topic to publish-ready piece, in three stages. Research & brief: map what already ranks for your keyword, read the search intent, find the underserved angle, gather three to five citable sources, and shape a writing brief. Draft: write the full piece to that structure. Optimize: a single polishing pass over search signals, readability, structure, snippet metadata and internal links that outputs the deliverable version. Run them in sequence or enter at any stage.

The rules are firm: no 'studies show' without a number you can cite, headings promise only what the body delivers, and every claim and figure stays traceable to a saved source. The piece, its sources and its media bundle live in your workspace.

It is a production line, not a channel: nothing publishes or posts by itself — the finished piece comes back to you and your own outlets. Ask too vaguely ('write about AI') and it pushes back: who reads this, and what's their problem?

useCases.zh-Hans: 从关键词与竞争分析出发产出内容简报，再顺写长文
useCases.en: Produce a keyword-and-competition brief, then write the long-form piece from it

useCases.zh-Hans: 给既有草稿过 SEO、可读性与内链的优化整备
useCases.en: Put an existing draft through an SEO, readability and internal-link tune-up

useCases.zh-Hans: 把研究来源、配图与表格整理成可复查的资源包
useCases.en: Bundle sources, images and tables into a reviewable resource package

useCases.zh-Hans: 批量生产系列文时保证角度不重叠、结构一致
useCases.en: Keep a multi-article series non-overlapping in angle and consistent in structure

prompt.zh-Hans: 目标关键词「offline transcription privacy」：先看排名内容找缺口，给我简报——角度、读者意图、三到五个来源和大纲，别开始写作。
prompt.en: Target keyword 'offline transcription privacy': map what ranks, find the gap, and deliver the brief — angle, reader intent, three to five sources, outline. Don't start drafting yet.

output.zh-Hans: 一份写作简报：现有内容的角度盘点、读者意图判断、带出处的来源清单和逐节大纲。
output.en: A writing brief: competitor-angle map, reader-intent read, a cited source list and section outline.

prompt.zh-Hans: 这篇 2000 词草稿按优化段整备：可读性提到技术读者能接受、大段落补小标题、给出三个内链位置、逐条列改了什么与为什么。
prompt.en: Put this 2,000-word draft through the optimize stage: lift readability for a technical audience, add subheads to long stretches, propose three internal-link slots, and list every change with its reason.

output.zh-Hans: 可发布的新副本与逐项优化记录；来源与数字保持可追溯。
output.en: A publish-ready new copy plus a change-by-change optimization log, keeping sources and figures traceable.

overview.zh-Hans:
让社媒发帖背后有一条清晰的策略线：先确认目标（认知、线索、流量、社区）、受众活跃在哪些平台、你的语气边界和能投入的时间，再搭出三到五个内容支柱并配比，配上各平台的格式与节奏建议（轮播、串帖、短视频等）和开场钩子写法。

产出是能直接用的素材：逐条成稿的帖子文案与话题标签、按支柱铺开的两周排期表、把长文拆成系列帖的复用方案；热点与同类账号的参考用应用自带的检索完成。草稿和日历都保存在工作区或手记里。

一条边界：它只生成内容和排期建议，不对接任何平台、不代你发帖——发布始终是你自己在平台上的动作。
overview.en:
Social with a strategy line behind the posts. It starts with goals (awareness, leads, traffic, community), where your audience actually engages, your tone boundaries and realistic time budget; then builds three to five content pillars with mix percentages, per-platform format and cadence suggestions (carousels, threads, short video) and hook patterns.

The output is usable material: drafted post copy with hashtags, a two-week calendar laid out across the pillars, repurposing passes that split a long piece into a post series — trend and peer-account checks run through the app's own search. Drafts and calendars live in your workspace or Notes.

One boundary: it generates content and scheduling suggestions only. It connects to no platform and never posts for you — publishing stays your own action.

useCases.zh-Hans: 为一个新产品账号搭内容支柱与两周发帖日历
useCases.en: Set up content pillars and a two-week posting calendar for a new product account

useCases.zh-Hans: 把一篇长博客拆成 LinkedIn 轮播与 X 串帖
useCases.en: Repurpose a long blog post into a LinkedIn carousel and an X thread

useCases.zh-Hans: 按品牌语气审改草稿队列，去掉不像你的句子
useCases.en: Edit a draft queue to brand voice, removing lines that don't sound like you

useCases.zh-Hans: 追踪同类账号的热点形式，产出带钩子的候选帖
useCases.en: Track what formats are working for comparable accounts and draft hooked candidates

prompt.zh-Hans: 目标是小团队的获客：按 4 个内容支柱给两周排期，LinkedIn 每周 3、X 每天 1，先出支柱配比与每帖一句钩子。
prompt.en: Goal: small-team lead gen. Build a two-week calendar across 4 content pillars — 3 LinkedIn and 1 X post per day — showing the pillar mix and a one-line hook per post first.

output.zh-Hans: 工作区里的排期文件：支柱占比、逐日平台与钩子句；发布由你手动完成。
output.en: A workspace calendar: pillar mix, per-day assignments and hooks — posting stays manual and yours.

prompt.zh-Hans: 这篇「PDF 工作流」长文改成一条 6 帖的 X 串：每帖独立成立、第二帖放最强论点、最后回链原文。
prompt.en: Turn this 'PDF workflows' article into a 6-post X thread: each stands alone, the strongest argument in post two, a link-back at the end.

output.zh-Hans: 6 条可直接取用的帖子草稿与钩子顺序说明；数字与主张沿用原文来源。
output.en: Six ready-to-use post drafts with the hook ordering explained, carrying the article's own sources for every figure and claim.

overview.zh-Hans:
用你自己的语气起草邮件：先看你对这封邮件的明确要求，再用你授权打开的已发样本、手记或工作区文件，最后参考你平时维护的语气习惯；都没有时，它会先问一句语气方向，而不是默认公文腔。事实和数字只从你给的材料里来，核对不了的留成带提醒的占位，绝不编造。

交付包括两三个简短的主题候选、把请求放在前面的正文、纯文本与可选的网页格式版本，附件以工作区文件路径引用。成稿放进你的邮件流程——写信页、剪贴板或草稿文件；发送、收件人和日程永远由你决定。涉及财务、法务或人事的内容，会附上发送前人工过目的提醒。
overview.en:
Drafted in your own voice. It starts from your instructions for this specific email, then the samples you chose to open — sent mail, Notes, workspace files — or the tone profile you keep; if there's nothing to learn from, it asks one line of tone direction instead of defaulting to corporate-speak. Facts and figures come only from what you provide; anything unverifiable stays as a warned placeholder, never invented.

You receive two or three short subject options, a body that states the ask early, plain text plus an optional HTML variant, and attachments referenced by workspace path. The draft lands where your mail flow takes over — compose, clipboard or draft file. Sending, recipients and scheduling remain entirely yours, and finance, legal or HR-sensitive drafts carry a read-before-send reminder.

useCases.zh-Hans: 写一封礼貌但不背锅的逾期付款跟进
useCases.en: Write a polite follow-up on a late payment without accepting blame

useCases.zh-Hans: 把任务成果整理成一封给上级的进展邮件
useCases.en: Turn task results into a progress email to your manager

useCases.zh-Hans: 按我的历史邮件语气起草回复
useCases.en: Draft a reply that matches the tone of my past emails

useCases.zh-Hans: 同一封邮件要纯文本与 HTML 两个版本
useCases.en: Produce both plain-text and HTML variants of one email

prompt.zh-Hans: 给客户写催款邮件：发票 7 月 12 日到期未付，语气坚定、给对方台阶、不承诺任何新账期。细节缺的留占位。
prompt.en: Draft a payment reminder: the invoice was due July 12 and is unpaid — firm tone, keep their dignity, promise no new terms. Leave unknown details as placeholders.

output.zh-Hans: 2–3 个主题候选加正文草稿，日期与单号与简报一致，未核实的人名金额是带警告的占位符；发送与否由你决定。
output.en: 2–3 subject options and a body draft whose dates and invoice number trace to the brief, with warned placeholders for anything unverified; sending remains your call.

prompt.zh-Hans: 参考我上个月发给学校的那封请假邮件的语气，替我起草这次的请假回复，简短、手机上能读完。
prompt.en: Using the tone of the excuse email I sent the school last month, draft this reply — brief enough to finish on a phone.

output.zh-Hans: 一份贴合所给样本语气的短稿；如果它听起来完全不像你的任何样本，会直说并给出两个替代语气。
output.en: A short draft matched to the sample's register; if it sounds nothing like your other samples, the draft says so and offers two alternatives.

overview.zh-Hans:
把「研究一下」变成一个可以复查、可以接着用的资料库，而不是一篇用完即弃的长文。适合代价高的问题：战略选择、商业计划、要发表的内容、需要真正检验的假设——风险低的快速问答不值得用这么重的流程。

它会先重新界定问题、锁定背后真正要做的决定，并写下两到四个可以被事实推翻的假设；然后多路并行检索，每个来源单独存档、附原文引句，按可信度、时效和立场打分；一个结论要求至少三个不同类型的来源互相印证，成稿前还专门跑一轮「找反证」的自我质疑。找不到支撑的主张会被留空，而不是配一个像样的假引用。

最终交付一份带出处的报告，连同研究计划、来源索引和关键数据清单；一个月后要更新，只增量核对变化的部分。所有文件存在你的工作区里，随时可以逐条回查。
overview.en:
Research that lands as a folder you can revisit and extend — not a one-shot wall of text. Built for questions where being wrong is expensive: strategy calls, business plans, published pieces, hypotheses that must actually be tested. Low-risk quick answers don't deserve this weight.

It reframes the question first, pins the decision behind it and commits two to four falsifiable hypotheses; then fans searches out in parallel, archives every source as its own file with verbatim quotes, and scores it on credibility, recency and stance. A conclusion needs at least three sources of different kinds backing it, and the synthesis includes a deliberate hunt for disconfirming evidence — a claim without a source stays empty instead of gaining a plausible-looking citation.

You receive a cited report plus its plan, source index and key figures; a month later an update checks only what changed. Everything lives in your workspace, auditable line by line.

overview.zh-Hans:
精读不是缩写：它帮你重建作者的论证——核心主张是什么、推理怎么搭、证据在哪里、哪些其实只是例子、哪里藏着没说出口的假设、反方会怎么反驳。按需要选模式：快速要点、深度论证拆解、可转成思维导图的知识地图、费曼式复述检验（你讲，它找断点，再补一个准确的说法、一个类比和复习计划），或整本书的章节脉络与综合。

超长材料会按内容分段消化后再统一综合；每个重要论断都记录它和上级主张的关系，证据条目锚定到页码或章节；抽取不完整的部分明说，不靠它立论。

它只处理你给的材料：上网找来源交给深度调研，套格式的高管摘要交给摘要技能。笔记、主张地图和记忆卡片都会存回你的工作区或手记，长期可翻。
overview.en:
Close reading, not shortening. It reconstructs the author's argument: the central claim, how the reasoning is built, where the support actually sits, what is only an example quietly promoted into a rule, which premises go unstated, and how a skeptic would push back. Modes on demand: quick gist, deep argument breakdown, a mind-map-ready knowledge map, the Feynman check (you explain, gaps get located, then the corrected version, an analogy and a review plan), or whole-book chapter mapping and synthesis.

Very long material is split on content boundaries, digested part by part and synthesized once more; major claims record their relation to the ones above them, evidence entries are pinned to page or section, and incomplete extraction is stated rather than leaned on.

It works only on material you hand over — finding sources belongs to deep research, templated exec briefs to the summarizer. Notes, claim maps and recall cards write back to your workspace or Notes, durable and revisitable.

overview.zh-Hans:
按规范方法做文献综述——系统综述、范围综述或叙述综述。先定研究问题和检索计划，再跨多个学术来源检索、逐条筛入或排除并给出各阶段的数量统计；记录按 DOI 等信息去重归并，逐篇提取证据表，最后综合成文并核对引文与出处。检索式和筛选标准都保留在文档里，别人可以照着复跑。

引文核对只对已经取回的记录进行：能验证的验证，验证不了的明确标注缺失，绝不美化不存在的文献；某个数据库当时够不到，就直说够不到；没读到的原文不会被转述。

产出是工作区里的一整套综述材料：检索协议、筛选记录、证据表与综述初稿。
overview.en:
Literature reviews done to method — systematic, scoping or narrative. Define the question and search plan, retrieve across academic sources, screen records in and out with counts at each stage, deduplicate and merge by DOI and identifiers, extract per-study evidence tables, synthesize into text and check citations against sources. The queries and eligibility criteria stay in the documents so anyone can re-run them.

Citation checking works only against records already retrieved: what can be verified is verified, what can't is marked missing, an unreachable database is named rather than glossed, and nothing is paraphrased from text that was never fetched.

The deliverable is a full review kit in your workspace: protocol, screening record, evidence tables and a drafted review.

overview.zh-Hans:
让参考文献不再靠手抄：检索学术数据库（OpenAlex 覆盖多学科，PubMed 是生物医学的首选——只搜一个库正是参考清单偏斜的头号原因），把 DOI、PMID、arXiv 编号或论文链接换成完整题录，产出干净的 BibTeX；已有的引文列表可以批量核对、去重和清洗格式。

数据库返回的记录常有残缺，它会对照出版方页面补齐卷期页码并记下核查来源；线上优先的文章保持真实的出版状态，缺的信息宁可空着也不编造。可选的检索账号密钥只有你自己配置过才会使用。

overview.en:
References without hand-copying: search academic databases (OpenAlex for broad coverage, PubMed as the biomedical authority — single-database searching is the top cause of a lopsided reference list), turn DOIs, PMIDs, arXiv IDs or article links into complete records, and emit clean BibTeX; existing bibliographies get batch-validated, deduplicated and reformatted.

Database records are often incomplete, so missing volume and pages get verified against the publisher's own page with the check logged; online-first articles keep their real publication state, and absent information stays honestly absent. Optional service keys are used only if you configured them yourself.

Manuscript diagrams go through the app's own drawing and canvas surfaces. Paired with literature-review it clicks: one finds and screens, the other cites and records.

overview.zh-Hans:
一套评估科学说法的思考工具：证据等级怎么看（从个案报道到系统综述），不同研究设计各自会带来什么偏倚，相关和因果的差距在哪，p 值和置信区间常见怎么被误读，结论通常在哪里过度外推。它也把方法本身讲给你听，帮你长出这双眼睛；需要时按分级框架给出证据质量评定和降级理由。

它评的是你带进来的材料——论文、报道、网页内容或文档——评估写成工作区文件或手记。主张找不到支撑就写「证据未提供」，拿不准的偏倚风险就标注拿不准：产出是可复查的评估，而不是「这篇不行」的一锤子判决。
overview.en:
A reasoning toolkit for weighing scientific claims: how to read the evidence hierarchy from case reports up to systematic reviews; which biases each study design invites; where correlation and causation part company; how p-values and confidence intervals commonly get misread; and where conclusions typically overreach past their data. It teaches the methods too, so the critical eye becomes yours; on request it grades evidence quality with explicit reasons for any downgrade.

It appraises what you bring in — papers, news coverage, fetched pages, documents — and writes the appraisal as a workspace file or Note. A claim without support is recorded as 'evidence not supplied', an uncertain bias call stays flagged: the output is an inspectable assessment, never a one-word verdict.

overview.zh-Hans:
把你手里已有的论文、文章和报告消化成结构化简报：核心论点、带证据的关键发现、方法、局限、可行动的要点，以及标注出处的原文引句；每份摘要还附带对来源可信度、证据强度、时效与立场的快速评估。

不止单篇：两到五份材料各自提炼后做对比，一致处、矛盾处、互补处一目了然；也可以从文档中抽取格式统一的引文清单。它只处理你提供的材料——需要先去网上找来源，那是调研类技能的活。

overview.en:
Digests the papers, articles and reports you already have into structured briefs: the central thesis, evidence-backed findings, method, limitations, actionable takeaways and page-anchored quotes — each with a quick read on the source's credibility, evidence strength, recency and bias signals.

Beyond single files: two to five documents get individually distilled and then compared, with agreements, contradictions and complements laid out; citation lists can be extracted in consistent formatting. It works on supplied material only — when sources still need to be found on the web, that's the research skills' job.

Briefs follow fixed templates so every output has the same shape, and land in your workspace or Notes for later reference.

overview.zh-Hans:
拿到一份陌生数据时，先了解它的结构和主要问题，再决定如何清洗、分析或建模。支持检查 CSV、TSV 和 JSON 中的字段类型、缺失情况、数据分布、异常线索，以及分组或时间划分中可能影响后续分析的问题。

提供数据文件、字段背景和关注的问题后，它会整理一份可复查的探索报告，说明检查范围、主要发现与建议的下一步，保留原始数据。需要时可用另一条分析路径交叉核对结果。基因组、医学影像等专业格式另有参考指南，不能直接当作已支持的自动解析格式；统计推断和因果判断也需要后续专门分析。
overview.en:
Understand an unfamiliar dataset before deciding how to clean, analyze or model it. The skill checks field types, missingness, distributions and outlier clues in CSV, TSV and JSON, including group or time splits that could affect later analysis.

Provide the files, field background and the questions you want to investigate. It helps produce a reviewable exploration report describing the scope, main findings and useful next steps while preserving the source data. A second analysis path can be used for cross-checking where available. Specialist formats such as genomics or medical imaging have reference guidance rather than built-in automatic parsing; statistical inference and causal questions require further analysis.

overview.zh-Hans:
把统计比较做成有纪律的流程：先写清假设、比较对象和判断标准，再按预先定好的方案执行检验——两组比较、配对设计、多组方差分析（含事后两两比较）、非参数检验、列联表与相关分析、常用回归，以及实验前的样本量测算。每次检验都附带效应量和置信区间，按学术报告格式给出描述统计与结果，不显著的发现同样如实呈现。

正态性、方差齐性等前提检查随报告给出，但只作提醒，不会自动替你换检验；数据缺格按规则处理并计数；同样的文件和方案能得到相同的结果，便于复核。

范围之外也明说：贝叶斯分析、多层模型、生存分析、元分析和时间序列建模不在其中——宁可说不做，不会给你近似糊过去。
overview.en:
Statistics with discipline: hypotheses, comparisons and decision thresholds are written down before anything runs, then executed from the prespecified plan — two-group and paired tests, analysis of variance with post-hoc comparisons, nonparametric tests, contingency tables and correlations, standard regression, and pre-experiment sample-size solving. Every result carries its effect size and confidence interval, reported with descriptives in academic style; non-significant findings stay in.

Assumption checks (normality, variance equality) accompany the report as information, never as an automatic switch of tests; missing cells follow stated rules with counts; the same data and plan reproduce the same numbers for review.

Out of scope, stated plainly: Bayesian analysis, multilevel models, survival analysis, meta-analysis and time-series fitting — declined rather than approximated.

output.zh-Hans: 完整的检验结果与报告，含效应量、置信区间与前提检查；异常筛查只报告，不自动换检验。
output.en: Full test results with effect sizes, confidence intervals and assumption checks; odd screens are reported, never used to auto-switch tests.

overview.zh-Hans:
先保住含义，再谈好看。这个流程教你做不撒谎的科研图：柱和面积从零点起，断轴必须声明；误差线说清是哪一种不确定度、样本量多少；缺失、零值和被排除的点用看得见的区分，而不是悄悄连线；能用双轴就尽量不用。原始数据、过滤规则、归一化方式与随机种子随图一起保存，成品会重新打开检查，而不是相信默认值。

在任务计算环境里出图：常用出版风格预设、色盲友好配色与文字对比检查，颜色之外再配形状或标注做第二重线索；导出 PNG、PDF、SVG，尺寸与字体可控。目标期刊的要求不靠猜：确认刊名与投稿阶段后，按现行官方指南核对，最后由人过目定稿。

静态出版图是这一版的交付物；自动检查只是辅助，合规与否要人来判。
overview.en:
Preserve meaning before optimizing looks. This workflow makes figures that don't lie: bars and areas start at zero, axis breaks are declared, error bars state which uncertainty and how much data behind them, missing/zero/excluded points are visibly distinguished rather than quietly connected, and dual axes get avoided where possible. Raw data, filters, normalizations and seeds stay filed beside the figure, and the delivered file is reopened and inspected instead of trusting defaults.

Plotting runs in the task's compute environment with publication style presets, color-blind-safe palettes and text-contrast checks — color always paired with a second cue like shape or label — exporting PNG, PDF and SVG at controlled sizes and fonts. Journal requirements are never guessed: identify journal, article type and stage, verify against current official guidance, then a human eye closes the loop.

Static publication figures are this release's deliverable; automated checks assist, but compliance calls remain human.

overview.zh-Hans:
把各类文档变成干净的 Markdown，选对路线是关键：单份 Word、HTML、RTF、纯文本走应用的原生转换，信息直接取自文件本身；能提取文字的 PDF 转成带页标记的 Markdown；扫描件交给文字识别，加密 PDF 先解锁再处理。批量目录转换、表格转写、幻灯片文字与演讲备注提取由随包工具完成——按真实放映顺序输出，公式没有可显示的值会明确警告，宏永不被执行。

每份转换都留下可查的记录：走的是哪条路、各输入输出一一对应、原件完好；不支持的格式会得到下一步建议，绝不猜格式硬转，全程不联网。转换出的文字按外部内容对待——后续步骤不执行它，也不信它自述的「成功」。

保留的是文字结构，不承诺像素级排版：图形、版式和复杂表格要用应用内预览核对。
overview.en:
Documents into clean Markdown, along the right route. Single Word, HTML, RTF and text files use the app's native conversion, reading structure directly from the file itself; extractable PDFs become Markdown with page markers; scans route to text recognition, and encrypted PDFs unlock first. Batch folders, spreadsheet tables and slide text plus speaker notes run through the bundled tooling — slides in true presentation order, formula cells with no displayable value warned loudly, macros never executed.

Each conversion leaves a traceable record: which route ran, inputs matched one-to-one with outputs, sources kept intact; unsupported formats get routing advice, never a guessed conversion, and nothing goes online. The resulting text is treated as outside content — later steps never execute it or trust its self-declared 'success'.

Text structure is preserved, pixel layout is not promised: figures, styling and complex tables get checked through in-app previews.

overview.zh-Hans:

提供算式、变量含义和必要假设后，它会协助选择求解方法、解释主要步骤，并通过回代、求导或数值抽查复核结果。输出可以整理成公式与推导说明，按需生成 LaTeX 或计算代码，便于写进报告、笔记或后续程序。可选数值扩展的使用范围取决于当前环境具备的能力。
overview.en:
Use exact symbolic computation for algebra, derivatives, integrals, series, equations, differential equations and matrices, with guidance for physics, number theory and geometry. It suits study, research calculations and problems where parameters or exact expressions need to remain visible.

Provide the expression, variable meanings and relevant assumptions. The skill helps choose a method, explain the main steps and check results through substitution, differentiation or numerical spot checks. Outputs can become formulas and derivation notes, LaTeX for a report, or calculation code for further work. Optional numerical extensions depend on the capabilities available in the current environment.

The skill helps establish a direction, prioritize improvements and carry them into code and copy. Refinement preserves the established visual identity and behavior; redesign reorganizes the visual expression around the same product facts. Page checks state their coverage so findings can be reviewed alongside real interactions.

overview.zh-Hans:
生成艺术，但种子说了算：先写一段计算哲学——什么过程在涌现什么、秩序与混沌在哪里拉扯——再从你的需求里推出概念种子，落在内置算法上生成作品。交付是一组配套文件：可交互的网页作品（换种子、调参数、调色板、切换算法、下载图片，单文件离线可用）、同一颗种子的静态图，以及保存下来的生成参数，凭种子可以原样重跑。

换一颗种子是姐妹作，同一个种子永远是同一件作品。想表达新哲学，可以在核心里增加算法。

页面效果以应用内真实打开和截图为准——数字核心正确不等于屏幕效果，最终以看得见的那一版定稿。
overview.en:
Generative art where the seed is law. Write a computational philosophy — what emerges from which process, where order and chaos pull — then deduce the conceptual seed from your brief and generate on the built-in algorithms. You receive a matched set: an interactive web piece (swap seeds, tune parameters and palettes, switch algorithms, download an image — one self-contained file that works offline), a static render of the same seed, and the saved generation parameters so the piece re-runs exactly from its seed.

A new seed is a sister piece; the same seed is always the same piece. New philosophies can extend the core with fresh algorithms.

On-screen behavior is judged by actually opening and capturing the page in the app — a correct numeric core isn't the same as the visible result, and what you see is what ships.

overview.zh-Hans:
把海报和图形版式当作有思想的手工件来做：先写一段视觉哲学——给这个方向起个两词的名字，比如「Brutalist Joy」「Chromatic Silence」，讲清它如何体现在空间、色彩、尺度与构图上；再从你的需求里推出那条安静的概念线索，在一页画布上完成九成视觉、一成必要文字的构图。

成稿按版式规格生成，排版引擎用字体的真实度量拦住两大类问题——内容出界和文字互相重叠；中日韩字形有覆盖核对。度量拦得住粗错，拦不住所有光学意外，所以最后一步仍是真人目验。字体随包配置，不下载外部字库。

SVG 与网页是源文件；需要整幅图片或 PDF 时，通过应用真实渲染后取图交付——不会声称未渲染的文件能自动导出。
overview.en:
Posters and graphic layouts as crafted objects with a thesis: write a short visual philosophy first — name the direction in two words, 'Brutalist Joy', 'Chromatic Silence' — saying how it lives in space, color, scale and composition; then deduce the quiet conceptual thread from your brief and compose one canvas at ninety percent visual, ten percent essential text.

The artifact is generated from a layout spec, using the fonts' real measurements to block the two classic disasters — content running off the page and text colliding — with coverage checks for Chinese and Japanese glyphs. Measurements catch blunders, not every optical edge case, so a human look is the final step. Fonts come bundled; nothing external is downloaded.

SVG and web pages are the source files; a full-size image or PDF is produced by rendering through the app for real, never promised from an unrendered file.

overview.zh-Hans:
十套成品主题随取随用：每套都有完整的配色、字体搭配与使用规则，另有一份展示册帮你先看图再决定。挑一套，或者按同样格式从你的需求生成一个新主题——新主题先存档，经你过目再投入使用。

「应用主题」是把确定的颜色和字体写进交付物本身：演示文稿、文档或网页直接带上这套外观。主题点名的是字体名称，不安装字体软件——设备上没有对应字体时，用可用的系统字体替代并明确告诉你换了哪处。

overview.en:
Ten complete themes ready to pick: each carries its full palette, font pairings and application rules, plus a showcase to browse before deciding. Choose one, or generate a new theme in the same format from your brief — new themes are saved for your review before use.

'Applying a theme' means its exact colors and fonts written into the deliverable itself: decks, documents or web pages arrive dressed. Themes name fonts rather than installing them; when a named font isn't on your device, an available system font stands in and the swap is disclosed.

The fit is concrete: a quarterly report that should feel deep blue-gray, course slides that should feel approachable and handmade, a blog re-skinned end to end — chosen once, consistent everywhere.

From one brand color to a handoff-ready design system: the primary expands into full color families, joined by font, size and weight scales, a spacing system, radii and shadow tiers — computed by recorded rules, so identical inputs give identical output, never mood-board improvisation. Component architecture docs, responsive breakpoint and fluid type math, and variable exports (CSS, SCSS and friends) for developer handoff come along, with contrast checks threaded throughout.

Everything lands as reviewable workspace documents: token tables, component specs, responsive rules, handoff notes. The trigger phrasing is plain — 'generate a palette', '8pt grid', 'export CSS variables', 'prepare handoff' — all route here.

It builds systems and specs so an interface gains a reusable language instead of one beautiful throwaway screen.

overview.zh-Hans:
让研究结论直接长成设计的语言。四条工作流：用户画像——把你收集的问卷、访谈或分析数据按简单格式整理进来，得到有证据背书的用户原型，目标与痛点逐条能回指数据；旅程地图——阶段、触点、情绪起伏与机会点逐层摆开；可用性测试计划——任务脚本、招募标准、样本量参考与成功判据，写成可以直接执行的方案；研究综合——多份访谈的发现归并成按优先级排序的问题与机会清单。

方法论文件随包携带，需要估算样本量时按记录的方法执行。「建用户画像」「画旅程图」「设计可用性测试」「综合访谈」——这些说法都会走到这里。

产出落在工作区文档里，设计师和产品可以接着往下用——研究不该死在报告抽屉里。
overview.en:
Findings that grow into design language. Four workflows. Personas: organize your survey, interview or analytics data in a simple format and get evidence-backed archetypes — every goal and pain traceable to the data. Journey maps: stages, touchpoints, the emotional curve and opportunity gaps laid out in layers. Usability test plans: task scripts, recruiting criteria, sample-size guidance and success metrics, written as a protocol you can run. Research synthesis: findings from multiple interviews merged into a prioritized list of problems and opportunities.

Methodology files ship inside, and sample-size estimates follow the recorded method. 'Build a persona', 'map the journey', 'plan a usability test', 'synthesize interviews' — all route here.

Deliverables land as workspace documents designers and product can pick up directly. Research shouldn't die in a report drawer.

overview.zh-Hans:
帮助检查和改进 React 项目的组件结构、状态管理、数据流与性能，适合开发新界面、整理逐渐复杂的组件，或排查渲染和加载问题。内容覆盖状态放置、Effect 使用、列表标识、异步竞态、代码拆分及表单处理等常见决策。

提供相关代码和当前问题后，它会结合项目结构逐项检查，说明建议、适用条件与可能的取舍。性能修改以测量和实际构建结果为依据，测试关注用户可见的行为。交付可包括改进清单、代码调整建议和复查步骤，便于团队在后续开发中沿用同一套规则。
overview.en:
Review and improve a React project's component structure, state management, data flow and performance. It suits new interfaces, growing components and investigations into rendering or loading problems. Guidance covers state placement, effects, stable list keys, asynchronous races, code splitting and forms.

Provide the relevant code and the problem you want to address. The skill reviews it in context and explains recommendations, conditions and tradeoffs. Performance changes rely on measurements and real build results, while tests focus on behavior users can observe. Deliverables can include an improvement list, suggested code changes and follow-up checks that a team can reuse during later development.

overview.zh-Hans:
写给 React 开发者的组件构成指南，主题只有一个：怎么设计组件的边界，让它长大时不 fork。十条模式各说清解决的问题和接受的代价：children 当内容插槽、props 当开关，一个挂六个布尔开关的组件其实是三个组件；成组组件共享一条只负责结构接线的内部契约，不夹带业务数据；用显式变体取代布尔参数汤，让不可能的组合根本写不出来；两个兄弟要商量的状态放到共同父节点；空槽位、加载中、空列表都要有自己的形状；逃生舱最后才用并且要有名字；布局只管几何、内容只管含义；测试贴着公开接口和用户可见行为走。

配套的模式卡把每条展开成可套用的写法，适合评审组件 API、拆解布尔参数膨胀、给团队一套共同的说法。
overview.en:
A React composition guide on one theme: shape component boundaries so they grow without forks. Ten patterns, each naming the problem it solves and the cost it accepts. Children as content slots, props as knobs — a component with six boolean flags is really three components. Compound pieces share one internal contract for structural wiring only, never business data. Explicit variants replace boolean soup, so impossible combinations simply can't be written. State negotiated between siblings lifts to their common parent. Empty slots, loading content and empty lists each carry their own shape. Escape hatches come last and named; layout owns geometry while content owns meaning; tests ride public props and user-visible behavior.

Pattern cards expand each rule into applicable code — for reviewing component APIs, taming boolean-prop sprawl, and giving the team one shared vocabulary.

overview.zh-Hans:
一份可逐条核对的网页设计清单，把「凭感觉」赶出评审。无障碍是底线：按钮和链接语义正确、控件都有名字、键盘走得通、焦点看得见、文字与界面元素对比达标、尊重减弱动效的设置、表单报错说清错在哪、触控目标够大。设计系统这半边管：字体族不过量、字号有比例、间距有节奏、颜色按语义命名、悬停/聚焦/禁用/加载等状态被认真设计过、内容随宽度重排而不是缩小、可点的东西看起来可点、按钮文案写出动作的结果、卡片不无意义叠卡片。

检查页面时，每条问题都要指明条目、依据和现场证据——截图、页面结构或代码位置；「看着不对」不成为结论。自动工具只能发现约三成问题，所以配套了规定的实时走查与源码核对步骤。

它是评审标准；大规模的无障碍修复目录在无障碍审计条目那边。
overview.en:
A checkable design checklist that pushes 'vibes' out of review. Accessibility is the floor: real button and link semantics, every control named, keyboard paths that work, visible focus, contrast that meets the numbers, motion that respects reduced-motion settings, form errors that say what's wrong and where, touch targets you can actually hit. The design-system half: font families under a limit, a proportional type scale, spacing with rhythm, colors named by meaning, hover/focus/disabled/loading states designed rather than defaulted, content that reflows instead of shrinking, clickable things that look clickable, button copy that names the outcome, and card-on-card stacks that add only chrome get flagged.

When reviewing a page, each issue cites its checklist item, its basis and live evidence — a screenshot, the page structure, or a source line; 'looks off' is not a conclusion. Automated tools catch about thirty percent of issues, so prescribed live walks and source passes carry the rest.

It is the review standard; the deep remediation catalog lives with the accessibility-audit entry.

overview.en:
Check whether a web app's important journeys work as intended, from a new feature or bug fix to a pre-release regression pass. Start with a runnable project or a page URL, and describe the screens and actions that matter most.

The skill helps plan test cases, then opens pages, clicks controls, fills forms and checks the resulting state. Results record both successful and failed checks, with problem locations, reproduction steps and useful screenshots so you can move on to repairs and retesting. overview.zh-Hans:
一套完整的网页无障碍审计：找出 WCAG 2.2 A/AA 级的问题——语义结构、标题层级、控件命名、图片替代文本、键盘可达、焦点顺序、ARIA 用法、颜色对比——每条按严重程度分级、定位到文件和行，并给出你所用框架的改前改后写法。修完后以首轮结果为基线复查，确认问题关闭、没有引入新麻烦。

对比度按 WCAG 规定的算法计算（正文 4.5:1、大字与界面元素 3:1），页面还可以在应用里打开，做键盘遍历和无障碍结构检查——自动检查大约只能发现三成问题，剩下的靠这些规定的人工步骤补齐。

交付是可复查的资产：问题清单、逐条修复、写给开发者/产品/合规读者的报告，并可接入 CI 防止后续回归。
overview.en:
A complete web accessibility audit: finds WCAG 2.2 A/AA issues — semantics, heading order, control names, image alt text, keyboard reachability, focus sequence, ARIA usage, color contrast — grading each by severity, pinning it to file and line, and supplying before/after patterns for your framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte or plain HTML). After fixes, the same pass re-checks against the first findings as a baseline, confirming issues closed and nothing new introduced.

Contrast is computed with WCAG's own formula (4.5:1 body text, 3:1 large text and UI); live pages additionally get a keyboard walk and accessibility-structure check inside the app's browser. Automated scanning catches roughly thirty percent of problems — the prescribed manual steps here cover the rest.

Deliverables are re-checkable assets: a findings list, per-issue fixes, reports written for developers, product and compliance readers, and CI hooks that guard the future.

overview.zh-Hans:
调试的流程纪律，专治「改改看」。先把现象固定下来：出错原文、触发条件、最短的能稳定复现的路径；不急着碰症状，而是顺着调用链往上问「是谁调用了它」，一层层追到最初的触发点——补丁打在症状旁边，只会保证复发；再只立一个当下最可能的假设，用最小实验去证实或推翻；修复之前先让一个失败测试存在，它钉住症状，也证明修好的是真问题。之后在入口、业务规则、环境检查几层各设一道防线，让这类问题不再无声复发。

配套参考讲透三件常被忽略的事：追溯时留下线索的时机、在一堆测试里定位谁污染了共享状态，以及用「等条件成立」代替「固定等几秒」。

读代码用任务的工具，跑测试用项目自己的命令、在授权环境里进行——快修不是交付物，根因和回归测试才是。
overview.en:
Debugging discipline that cures 'try a tweak'. First, fix the symptom in place: the exact error, its trigger, the shortest path that reproduces it reliably. Second, instead of patching next to the symptom, walk up the chain asking 'who called this?' until you reach the original trigger — padding beside the symptom only guarantees a repeat. Third, hold exactly one current hypothesis and design the smallest experiment that could falsify it. Fourth, before fixing, create a test that fails — it nails the symptom and proves the patch killed the real bug. Afterwards, set guards at the entry point, in the business rules and with environment checks, so the whole class of problem stops recurring silently.

The references cover three routinely ignored skills: when to leave breadcrumbs along the trace, how to find which test pollutes shared state, and waiting on conditions instead of the clock.

Reading code uses the task's tools; tests run with the project's own commands in its authorized environment. The quick patch is not the deliverable — the root cause and its regression test are.

overview.zh-Hans:
测试先行的完整纪律，钉在项目的真实命令上：先弄清这个代码库实际怎么跑测试（命令属于项目自己的文档与构建配置），然后红—绿—重构——亲眼看新测试因为功能还不存在而失败，写下刚好让它变绿的最简实现，再在全部保持通过的保护下整理结构。跳过「看它红」这一步，等于允许一条从没失败过的测试假装守住了行为。

好测试的标准同样可执行：名字说清「什么坏了」；测真实对象而不是替身的礼貌；测试与实现同一批交付。再加变异自检——故意把实现改坏一处，如果全套仍然通过，那些测试测的是空气；常见假测试信号也配了对照清单。

所有命令都在授权环境里用项目真实入口跑，通过与否以实际输出为准——「应该能过」不是结果。适合新功能落地、缺陷钉死，和一切「先证明再合并」的场合。
overview.en:
Full test-first discipline, anchored to how this codebase actually runs its tests — that command belongs to the project's own docs and build configuration. Then red-green-refactor: watch the new test fail because the capability genuinely doesn't exist yet, write the minimum that turns it green, reshape only while everything stays green. Skipping the 'watch it fail' step licenses a test that never proved anything to pretend it guards behavior.

Good tests meet executable standards: the name says what breaks, tests exercise the real thing rather than polite stand-ins, tests ship in the same batch as the implementation. Add the mutation check — deliberately break one line of the code; if the whole suite still passes, those tests were guarding air. Common fake-test signals (mirror-image structure, coverage padding, assertions on internals) come with a comparison list.

Commands run with the project's real entrypoints in the task's authorized environment, and 'should pass' is never a result. Built for landing new features, nailing defect fixes, and every 'prove it before merge' setting.

overview.zh-Hans:
为一组代码改动准备结构清楚的评审：梳理实现了什么、对应哪些需求、需要检查的提交范围，以及功能完整性、行为正确性、代码结构和测试覆盖中的重点风险。适合功能合并前检查、修复复核或较大改动的阶段性验收。

提供需求、相关提交或差异和已知关注点后，它会协助整理评审材料，给出按重要程度排列的问题与建议，并说明对应代码位置和判断依据。结果也会标明本次未覆盖的范围与待验证事项，方便决定先修什么、补哪些测试，以及何时可以继续集成。
overview.en:
Prepare a structured review of a set of code changes: what was implemented, which requirements it addresses, the commit range to inspect, and the main risks in completeness, correctness, structure and testing. Use it before merging a feature, checking a fix or reviewing a substantial stage of work.

Provide the requirements, commits or diff and your known concerns. The skill helps organize the review, rank findings and suggestions by importance, and identify the relevant code locations and supporting evidence. Results also state what was outside the review and what still needs verification, helping you decide which fixes and tests come next and when integration can proceed.

overview.zh-Hans:
PM 日常四件套，每件都有可复跑的工序。需求排序：把支持工单、销售阻塞、技术债和战略目标收进同一张输入表，按 RICE 打分，再看组合是否健康——速赢与大注的比例、工作量有没有全压在少数大项上、和战略的缺口在哪，再落成路线图草案。用户访谈：逐字稿进去，按主题聚类的发现出来，每条结论带着可回指的引语。PRD：从随包模板起草，把探索结论填进目标、范围、非目标与度量。

输入模板和评分公式都在包里，同样的输入算出同样的分数——排序争议可以回到数字上解决，而不是比嗓门。

产出都是可评审的工作区文档：评分表、访谈综合、路线图和 PRD 草稿。给已经存在的系统补规格，可以用配套的 Code→PRD 从反方向接手。
overview.en:
The PM's four daily crafts, each with a re-runnable procedure. Prioritization: feed support tickets, sales blockers, technical debt and strategy into one input sheet, score with RICE, then read the portfolio — quick wins versus big bets, effort piled onto a few items, strategic gaps — and draft the roadmap from it. Interviews: transcripts in, theme-clustered findings out, every conclusion carrying quotes you can point back to. PRDs: start from the bundled templates and fill goals, scope, non-goals and metrics from your discovery work.

Input templates and scoring formulas ship in the package, so identical inputs produce identical scores — ranking disputes settle back into the numbers instead of into volume.

Outputs are reviewable workspace documents: score tables, interview syntheses, roadmaps and PRD drafts. For writing specs of systems that already exist, its companion Code→PRD covers the reverse direction.

overview.zh-Hans:
在承诺投入开发之前，把产品想法拆成可以小步验证的选择。先钉住一个可度量的结果（现状基线与目标期限），再搭一棵机会解决方案树：结果之下是有用户证据支撑的机会点，机会之下是候选方案，方案之下是最快能学到东西的小实验——至少攒出三个不同的机会再收敛。

然后把假设摊上桌面：用户是否想要、商业上是否成立、技术上是否可行、用起来是否顺手，四类各自按风险和不确定程度打分，从最危险的那条开始设计验证。问题侧用访谈确认频率、痛感和解决意愿，弱信号趁早放弃；方案侧先做原型，测概念与真实行为，看人做什么而不是说什么。

节奏排成一到两周的探索循环：每轮带着明确假设、每天过证据，结束时做一个决定——继续、转向还是停止。留在工作区的是树、假设清单和循环计划，不是又一份没人读的报告。
overview.en:
Before committing to building, break the product idea into small verifiable bets. Pin one measurable outcome (baseline and target horizon), then grow an opportunity-solution tree: under the outcome, opportunities backed by user evidence; under those, candidate solutions; under those, the fastest-learning experiments — at least three distinct opportunities before converging.

Then put assumptions on the table: do users want it, does the business hold, can it be built, is it usable — each scored by risk and uncertainty, tested from the riskiest outward. On the problem side, interviews confirm frequency, pain and willingness to act, and weak signals die early; on the solution side, prototypes test concept and value by watching behavior, not stated preference.

The cadence is a one-to-two-week discovery loop with explicit hypotheses, daily evidence reviews and a closing call: proceed, pivot or stop. What stays in your workspace is the tree, the assumption map and the loop plan — not another report nobody rereads.

overview.zh-Hans:
把一个已经存在的代码库反推成完整的产品需求文档：先全局扫描识别技术栈，再逐页、逐接口分析，最后生成结构化文档。前端覆盖 React、Vue、Angular、Svelte、Next.js、Nuxt、SvelteKit、Remix、Astro；后端覆盖 NestJS、Express、Django、FastAPI、Flask；全栈项目把页面与接口合到一份统一文档。路由、组件、状态、模型与接口逐项取证，演示数据与真实接口区分开——假数据不会被写成产品事实。

文档写给两批读者：产品和合作方能读懂每个页面做什么，工程和 AI 代理能据此重建字段、交互与关系。

交付是一个 PRD 文档包：逐页说明、枚举字典、接口清单与数据模型。过程只读代码、只写新文档，被分析的工程不会被改动。
overview.en:
Reverse-engineer an existing codebase into a complete PRD: a global scan identifies the stack, page-by-page and endpoint-by-endpoint analysis follows, then structured documents are generated. Frontends covered: React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Remix, Astro; backends: NestJS, Express, Django, FastAPI, Flask; fullstack projects merge pages and APIs into one document. Routes, components, state, models, enums and calls are evidenced one by one, and demo fixtures are distinguished from real integrations — mock data never gets written up as product truth.

Two audiences are served: product and partners read what each page does, while engineers or AI agents get enough detail to reconstruct fields, interactions and relationships — business language, zero business details omitted.

The delivery is a PRD package: per-page documents, an enum dictionary, an API inventory and model schemas, with a completeness check attached. The process only reads code and writes new documents; the analyzed project itself is never modified.

overview.zh-Hans:
多数会议本该是一封邮件——这个流程把「该不该开」变成一道可回答的题。先为会议定价：人数乘时长乘人力成本，然后过三道检查：没有决策要发生，判异步——改发备忘，这个结论本身就是赢；有决策但议程或负责人缺位，判未就绪，点名缺什么；三样齐了才值得开，并附上这场会总共花掉多少。

值得开的会才配议程：每个议题写明期望结果，空议题被拒绝；决策类排在讨论和知会之前；每段时间盒加上最后五分钟的行动复述，装不下就删减或拆分，直到通过。会议由你主持，议程就是你的台本。

会后把笔记给它：口头承诺、待办与「谁将在何时做什么」自动归成按负责人分组的清单，没主的标「无负责人」、没期的标「无期限」——每个行动都有主、有期，这场会才算开完。它从不自发邀请或群发；产出是你决定要不要发的文字。
overview.en:
Most meetings should be an email — this workflow turns 'should this exist' into an answerable question. Price the meeting: heads times hours times labor cost, then three checks. No decision to make ⇒ async; draft a memo instead — that verdict is a win. A decision but no agenda or owner ⇒ not ready, naming the gap. All three present ⇒ it earns its cost, stated as a total.

Only survivors get an agenda: every topic carries a desired outcome (empty ones are refused), decisions sort before discussion and information, and timeboxes plus a five-minute closing recap must fit — trim, split and re-check until they do. You run the meeting; the agenda is your script.

Afterwards the notes reveal their actions: commitments, to-dos and 'name will do X by Y' lines group into a checklist by owner, with no-owner and no-due-date flags. The meeting ends when every action has an owner and a date. It never sends invites or mass messages — the output is text you decide to send.

overview.zh-Hans:
整理文件不是一键乱动。它会先盘点：类型、大小、命名规律、修改时间，重复文件按内容识别而不是只看名字；然后把每个动作写成一条可审阅的计划，给出分组预览和撤销办法；你确认后才执行，先建目录、再逐项移动。所谓删除，其实是移入按日期命名的归档文件夹，随时可以整体找回；只有你明确点名归档里的文件，才会真正移除。

重名冲突、跨设备移动这类拿不准的情况只标记、不猜测；命名沿用你已有的文件夹风格，不推销「更理论化」的方案。大批量整理可以后台进行，关掉页面不打断。结束时逐条核对计划与实际结果：哪些动了、哪些没动，一目了然。
overview.en:
Organizing without chaos. It inventories first — types, sizes, naming patterns, dates, duplicates recognized by content rather than by name — then drafts a reviewable plan listing every move, rename and archive as one line, with grouped previews and undo paths. Only after you approve does it execute, parent folders before children. A 'delete' is really a move into a dated archive folder, restorable in bulk; actual removal happens only when you name archived items specifically.

Name collisions and cross-device oddities get flagged, not guessed around; naming follows your existing folders instead of pitching a prettier scheme. Large passes run in the background so closing the view never interrupts them, and the close-out checks plan against reality: what moved, what didn't, stated plainly.

Turn receipt photos and invoice PDFs into a searchable archive and a practical ledger. Extract vendor names, invoice numbers, dates, currencies, amounts and tax, distinguishing clear, uncertain and missing fields. Provide the files and your preferred filing structure. It helps organize material by vendor, year or number, create detailed worksheets and summaries, and list items that need confirmation. Recognition and spreadsheet handling reuse the app's existing capabilities. Illegible or inconsistent amounts remain marked for review so you can check them against the source receipts before relying on the ledger.
